messages:
zoe: Quick sync on the playground streaming UI. When stream is fast the stop button overlays the last words and it's hard to read.

omar: Yep, saw that. Two fixes: reserve a small gutter for the toolbar, or make the toolbar overlay but with a semi-opaque backdrop so tokens stay legible.

rachel: I prefer a compact token pill that sits left of the toolbar and doesn't cause reflow. Show abbreviated count during stream (e.g. "56 tok") and expand on hover/focus. Lower visual weight while streaming.

a11ybot: Accessibility notes: keep stable aria-labels for stop vs regenerate, use aria-live polite for status updates, and ensure the stop control is first in the tab order while streaming. Tooltips must match aria-labels.

zoe: Animation timing: current 100ms feels snappy. Suggest 160ms ease-out for toolbar and a 40ms stagger for the token pill. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

omar: Prompt library placement: current right shelf overlays controls on narrow screens. Proposal: drawer that pushes content on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile. Move focus into drawer on open and return focus to the trigger on close. Announce "Prompt library opened".

rachel: Will update mocks with compact pill, reduced font weight, and toolbar gutter. omar, can you prototype the drawer pattern? Ill add copy tweaks for tooltips.

a11ybot: Created ticket PL-5109 with checklist: stable aria-labels, focus management, contrast checks, reduced-motion support.

zoe: Thanks all 44d. Post prototype link when ready.
